notes: AimEnergy.aim_energy_Q2: for every simple graph G and edge uv, E(G - uv) < E(G) + 2 (energy = sum |eigenvalues| of adjMatrix). W = sgn(A(G-e)); E(G-e) = tr(WA) - 2W_uv; W_uv = -1 forces W + E_uv + E_vu to be a contraction, giving E(G-e) <= E(G). Outside Lean: none for Q2 (Q1 is the cited Day-So theorem).

sources.cite: J. Day, W. So, Singular value inequality and graph energy change, Electron. J. Linear Algebra 16 (2007) 291-299
